evidence.title: GitHub - franken-ui/ui: Franken UI is an HTML-first UI component library built on UIkit 3 and extended with LitElement, inspired by shadcn/ui. · GitHub

name: Franken UI
summary: HTML-first UI component library built on UIkit 3: 60+ copy-paste components, premade pages and a Tailwind CSS theme.
description: A framework-agnostic component library built on UIkit 3 and extended with LitElement, covering accordion, alert, modal, dropdown, table, slideshow, navigation, forms and more, with shadcn/ui-inspired design. Install via CDN or npm/Vite (import from the franken-ui package), use uk-* attributes in plain HTML, and copy premade login pages and examples.
contains: 60+ components: accordion, modal, table, slideshow, tab, tooltip …
built on UIkit 3, extended with LitElement
install via CDN or npm + Vite plugin (franken-ui)
prebuilt Tailwind utilities (~91.45 kB gzipped) and Tailwind CSS v4 support
premade pages: 4 authentication pages and 3 examples
works with React and Vue using uk-* / data-uk-* attributes
